$comment: Canonical operational alert model for both systems (global-content-os + channel-content-os). Classification only: no paging vendor is configured. Runtime evaluators: GCOS apps/worker/src/ops-summary.ts (reads this file), CCOS mcp-server/src/ops/summary.ts (runtime copy, parity-tested against this file). A single ordinary source failure never pages.

classes.MUST_ALERT: A core flow is down or failing systemically. Act now: page the operator once a vendor exists; until then check /api/ops/summary + /ops/summary at least daily and on every deploy.
classes.SHOULD_ALERT: A capability is impaired or a pattern is forming. Handle within one working day.
classes.MANUAL_CHECK: Needs a human look during routine review. Never pages.

systemicRule: Systemic = at least a minimum count AND at least 50% of the relevant rows in the last 24 h (handoffs >= 3, callbacks >= 5, production jobs >= 3). A single failure is never systemic.

signals.condition: GET /api/ready answers 503 BLOCKED (DB unreachable or schema behind the code).
signals.response: docs/OPERATIONS.md section 5 (Bad Worker deploy / Bad migration).

signals.condition: /api/ready blocked reason DB_UNREACHABLE.
signals.response: Check Cloudflare D1 status and quota banner; do not redeploy blindly.

signals.condition: /api/ready 200 DEGRADED (token unset, handoff misconfigured, cron heartbeat stale, schema version unknown).
signals.response: Fix the listed reason (docs/OPERATIONS.md section 2).

signals.condition: /api/ready degraded reason CRON_HEARTBEAT_STALE (no feed fetch for > 60 min).
signals.response: Check the Worker cron trigger and recent ingress errors.

signals.condition: >= 3 approved_briefs approved in the last 24 h are handoff_status=failed and they are >= 50% of that window.
signals.response: Check CCOS /ready and CCOS_HANDOFF_URL/TOKEN; after the fix resend each failed brief (POST /api/handoff/resend).

signals.condition: At least one approved_brief is handoff_status=failed.
signals.response: POST /api/handoff/resend {briefId} (same briefId, stored immutable payload).

signals.condition: A failed brief reached the outbound attempt cap (MAX_HANDOFF_ATTEMPTS).
signals.response: Investigate the CCOS side before any further action; the cap is not bypassable.

signals.condition: A resend was answered 409: CCOS holds a DIFFERENT payload for the same briefId (immutability breach).
signals.response: Stop; compare approved_briefs.payload_json with CCOS approved_brief_intake.payload_hash. Never edit either side to force a match.

signals.condition: BUILD_COMMIT is not set on the running Worker.
signals.response: Next deploy: npx wrangler deploy $(node scripts/deploy-identity.mjs --wrangler-vars).

signals.condition: Run report scheduler.attention contains SYSTEMIC_FETCH_FAILURE (>= 50% of >= 4 selected sources failed).
signals.response: docs/OPERATIONS.md section 5 (Mass source failures): runner network / network-diagnose workflow.

signals.condition: No tip-toplulugu-python-runner run report for > 48 h (two missed daily runs).
signals.response: gh run list --workflow tip-toplulugu-python-runner.yml; re-run with workflow_dispatch.

signals.condition: scheduler.attention contains CAPACITY_DELAY (due sources not started this run).
signals.response: python adapters/tip-toplulugu-radar/scripts/tip_toplulugu_ops.py capacity --history <dir>.

signals.condition: scheduler.attention contains LATENESS_BEYOND_THRESHOLD (> 2880 min).
signals.response: tip_toplulugu_ops.py status; check capacity guard before any activation.

signals.condition: scheduler.attention contains RETRY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
signals.response: Inspect failure classes in report/run-report.json rows.

signals.condition: tip_toplulugu_ops.py capacity exits 2 (BLOCK) for the current active set.
signals.response: No activation; reduce load (cadence class) through a reviewed commit.

signals.condition: scheduler.attention contains MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED (>= 5 consecutive failures for a source).
signals.response: Investigate the named sources during routine review.

signals.condition: One ordinary source fetch failure. Per-source health; never gates readiness or release.
signals.response: None beyond routine source review.

signals.condition: GET /ready answers 503 BLOCKED (D1 binding/reachability, core schema, operator auth).
signals.response: channel-content-os docs/OPERATIONS.md.

signals.condition: /ready blocked reason DB_UNREACHABLE or DB_BINDING_MISSING.
signals.response: Check Cloudflare D1 status and the Worker D1 binding.

signals.condition: /ready 200 DEGRADED (intake token, callback config, schema 041, browser binding).
signals.response: Fix the listed reason.

signals.condition: >= 5 status callbacks attempted in the last 24 h failed and they are >= 50% of attempts.
signals.response: Check GCOS /api/ready (STATUS_CALLBACK_TOKEN) and GCOS_STATUS_URL/TOKEN; then POST /ops/callbacks/redeliver.

signals.condition: At least one approved_brief_intake row has callback_last_error.
signals.response: POST /ops/callbacks/redeliver (bounded, idempotent).

signals.condition: A brief reached REDELIVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_STATUS for its current status.
signals.response: Fix GCOS first, then POST /ops/callbacks/redeliver {briefId, resetExhausted:true} for that one brief.

signals.condition: >= 3 approved_brief jobs updated in the last 24 h are failed and they are >= 50% of that window.
signals.response: Inspect recentFailed in /ops/summary and get_job_stage_trace for one job; check PRODUCTION_FEEDBACK.

signals.condition: At least one approved_brief job is in failed (resumable from its last successful stage).
signals.response: Routine review of the job trace.

signals.condition: feedback_events is absent (migration 041 not applied): production feedback is not durable.
signals.response: Apply migration 041 through the authorized migration process.

signals.condition: Open PRODUCTION_FEEDBACK events (OBSERVED / NEEDS_REVIEW).
signals.response: Review per docs/FEEDBACK.md; feedback never changes rules by itself.

signals.condition: BUILD_COMMIT is not set on the running CCOS Worker.
signals.response: Next deploy: npx wrangler deploy $(node ../scripts/deploy-identity.mjs --wrangler-vars) from mcp-server/.
